when.test: Site == "ALL" or Site == null or Site == ""
BetweenSite == "ALL" or BetweenSite == null or BetweenSite == ""
Customer == "ALL" or Customer == null or Customer == ""
OrderType == "ALL" or OrderType == null or OrderType == ""
OrderFlag == "ALL" or OrderFlag == null or OrderFlag == ""

mapper.select:
WITH T_PN AS ( ) SELECT DISTINCT SQUOTED.SALFCY_0 AS SalesSite, SQUOTED.ITMREF_0 AS PN, SQUOTED.SQHNUM_0 AS QuoteNO, SQUOTED.SQDLIN_0 AS QuoteLine, SQUOTED.QUODAT_0 AS QuoteDate, SQUOTED.BPCORD_0 AS CustomerCode, BPCUSTOMER.BPCSHO_0 AS CustomerName, SQUOTED.QTY_0 AS QTY, SQUOTED.STU_0 AS Unit, SQUOTED.NETPRI_0 AS NetPrice, SQUOTE.CUR_0 AS Currency, CAST(SQUOTED.ORDFLG_0 AS SMALLINT) AS OrderFlag, SQUOTED.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO, ISNULL (CONVERT(VARCHAR, SORDER.ORDDAT_0, 120), '') AS OrderDate, SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 AS OriProjectNO FROM T_PN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SQUOTED SQUOTED ON T_PN.PN = SQUOTED.ITMREF_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SQUOTE SQUOTE ON SQUOTED.SQHNUM_0 = SQUOTE.SQHNUM_0 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER ON SQUOTED.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 AND SQUOTED.SOHNUM_0 != '' INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON SQUOTED.SOHNUM_0 = SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 AND SQUOTED.SOPLIN_0 = SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.BPCUSTOMER BPCUSTOMER ON BPCUSTOMER.BPCNUM_0 = SQUOTED.BPCORD_0 WHERE SQUOTED.NETPRI_0 > 0
ORDER BY SQUOTED.SALFCY_0 DESC, SQUOTED.QUODAT_0 DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
